name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>. '13' is the per-event handler-table dispatch index 0x13 (table base 0x51B91 + 0x13*4 = 0x51BDD holds this function's pointer), a meaningful domain ID, not address residue. Descriptor corrected from '__unref_char_cond' to '__ch5_boss_defeat': the slot is LIVE, reached via the ch5 kill-drop path -- ch5 char_spawn_record[5] = 卡特那 (the boss, enemy_data 49, char_id 0x75, lv8) carries pickup_kind=2 param=0x13, so 卡特那's death dispatches consequence[0x13]. The body is 卡特那's defeat / bandit-rout beat (defeat line + enemy AI rout + retreat call). The earlier 'unref' verdict only scanned turn-event/tile-step hooks and missed the kill-drop path.
purpose: Chapter 5 boss (卡特那) defeat / bandit-rout beat (dispatch table slot 0x13, reached via the ch5 kill-drop path): when 卡特那 (record[5], enemy_data 49, pickup_kind=2 param=0x13) dies, arm AI mode 7 (charge_dash) across the enemy band (chars 0x07..0x24), show 卡特那's defeat line (page 8), then re-scan the band and, if ANY enemy is still alive, show a bandit's retreat call (page 0xB).
logic_summary: any_alive=0. fd2_set_combat_aux_block_byte_d_low4_for_char_range(7,0x24,7) -> sets low 4 bits of runtime_char[i].combat_aux_block[0xD] (abs runtime_char offset 0x34) to 7 (charge_dash AI) for i in [7,0x24] inclusive (30 chars). fd2_display_dialog_scene(current_chapter_text, page=8, fixed geometry 0xA0000,0x140,0xCD,0x4C,0x4A,0x13,1) = 0x75 卡特那's defeat line. for (i=7; (int)i<0x25; i++): if fd2_check_char_is_dead(i)==0 (alive: runtime_char[i].bFlags bit0 clear at abs offset +5) set any_alive=1 -- NO early break, loop walks all 30 chars. if any_alive: fd2_display_dialog_scene(current_chapter_text, page=0xB, same geometry) = 0x60 '首領被打倒了！快逃啊！'. No RNG, no numeric computation; the sole branch is the any_alive gate.

params.name: event_arg
params.semantics: The uniform 1-arg cdecl dispatch argument from the per-event handler table at 0x51B91 (the kill-drop recipient/killer idx). This handler never reads it (cast to void).
params.reason: Name matches the established convention used across all sibling handlers in this file for the unread uniform dispatch arg. No address residue; accurately reflects its role.

returns.semantics: No return value. Visible side effects: writes the low nibble of combat_aux_block[0xD]=7 for runtime chars 0x07..0x24, and shows dialog page 8 (always) plus page 0xB (only if any of those chars is alive).

comment_original_issue: Source comment (chevt1.c) previously stated the slot was unreferenced / possibly cut content. Corrected: it is LIVE via the ch5 kill-drop path (record[5] 卡特那 pickup_kind=2 param=0x13), and identifies the beat as 卡特那's defeat / bandit rout.
notes: Verified via decompile + full disassembly + both key callees' plates. Disasm at 0x34716 confirms: __CHK(0x30); set_combat_aux_block(7,0x24,7); page-8 dialog; loop EBX=7..0x24 (no early break); MOVZX/CMP EAX,1 gate; page-0xB dialog. Callee semantics: fd2_set_combat_aux_block_byte_d_low4_for_char_range writes low4 of combat_aux_block[0xD] = abs offset 0x34 (value 7 = charge_dash AI mode); fd2_check_char_is_dead reads bFlags bit0 at abs offset +5. CLASSIFICATION CORRECTION (renamed unref_char_cond -> ch5_boss_defeat): the earlier 'unref/cut content' verdict was WRONG -- it only checked turn-event/tile-step hooks and missed that a spawn record's +0x16 pickup_kind==2 dispatches consequence[param] on death. ch5 record[5] = 卡特那 (enemy_data 49, char_id 0x75, the boss) has pickup_kind=2 param=0x13 (decoder-confirmed), so 卡特那's death dispatches this slot; page 8 (0x75 '..被一群小鬼打敗了，我不甘心') is 卡特那's defeat line and page 0xB (0x60 '首領被打倒了！快逃啊！') is the bandits' retreat call, both matching FDTXT entry 5. get_function_callers still returns none; sole xref is DATA from the dispatch-table slot 0x51BDD (the FDFIELD reference is runtime-computed, not a static xref).
